scope: Report-only reconciliation of two immutable57-lookup fresh-only pilots on the SAME19 previously exposed inputs. No new engine query, protected validation, personal history, installed IME or performance test.
selection: Two deterministic hash-picked ordinary cases per4–5/6–8/9–12 band in each old93/cycle1 cohort; two habitual-ng inputs per cohort; three established font controls. No successful-case filtering.
pool_retention: Full original first90 float-hex pools remain in immutable raw reports identified by SHA256. Public rows retain pool/order digests, exact target ranks, page metadata, all diagnostics/errors and all19 inputs/targets; candidate-pool text is omitted.
key_findings: Initial eager context completed0/19 context decodes in both context arms;19 capacity diagnostics per arm included18 raised exceptions and one retained static word/truncated page.
Lazy lexical control completed16/19 at weight0; weight0.25 completed5/19. Remaining3 control and14 weighted failures all hit the32,768-hypothesis budget.
V3 rejects capacity diagnostics/truncated fallback pages independently of whether a stored word is returned. Zero metadata/schema violations were observed in the lazy pilot.
Raw rank differences are retained to expose failures; comparing only successful queries would introduce selection bias. No sentence-accuracy or general improvement rate is inferred.
original_runner_gap: Initial runtime aggregation counted raised errors but not a swallowed capacity diagnostic on a returned direct-word page. Its raw diagnostics were intact; all original evidence is preserved. Reconciliation and v3 count that fallback as a failure.
